tasks.subject: Task 1: Install route — Shopify App Store entry point
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create `GET /api/shopify/install` — the URL Shopify hits when a merchant clicks Install.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/api/shopify/install/route.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Returns 503 if env vars missing
- [ ] Returns 403 if hmac present but invalid
- [ ] Returns 400 for bad shop domain
- [ ] Sets OAuth state cookie with tenantId:null when not logged in
- [ ] Redirects to Shopify OAuth URL

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/api/shopify/install/route.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["validates HMAC", "handles logged-in and unauthenticated", "sets OAuth state cookie"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: shopify-connect page and actions
tasks.description:

**Files:**

**Acceptance Criteria:**
